how_to_apply: Make sure you meet all the eligibility criteria in the advertisement before applying.
Open the online application form. Candidature is accepted only through this online application.
Fill in every part of the form, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Give a valid email ID, as all correspondence will be done through email only.
Submit the form before the deadline.
Documents to carry to the interview:
Original documents supporting the details given in the online form, including date of birth, qualifications and experience. Applicants without them will not be allowed to appear for the interview.
Internal candidates must submit a NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator.

The agency takes no responsibility for non-receipt of an online application. It is also not responsible for emails lost because of an invalid or wrong email ID, or delivered to spam or bulk mail folders. Receiving, downloading and printing related documents is the candidate's responsibility.

content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an Outsourcing Agency for the Supply of Manpower Services to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital (HBCH) and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC), Varanasi, on contract basis. This vacancy is for deployment at these two Varanasi cancer centres.

content_sections.heading: SBC Exports Genetic Counsellor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 35 years as on the last date of application. Educational qualification: Masters in Genetic Counselling, Human or Medical Genetics, Life Sciences, Psychology, Nursing or MSW. Essential experience: Minimum 01 year experience in Genetic Counselling. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants are initially screened on the basis of the information they provide in the online application form. Those screened in are called for an interview. Information about the interview date is sent by email to eligible candidates only. The agency reserves the right not to call any candidate for interview without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for six months and may be extended further, depending on the candidate's performance and the requirement of the institute. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. If a candidate does not meet the eligibility criteria, or has given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled at whatever stage this is found. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the candidate's services are liable to be terminated forthwith.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SBC Exports Genetic Counsellor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents to carry to the interview: Original documents supporting the details given in the online form, including date of birth, qualifications and experience. Applicants without them will not be allowed to appear for the interview. Internal candidates must submit a NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator. The agency takes no responsibility for non-receipt of an online application. It is also not responsible for emails lost because of an invalid or wrong email ID, or delivered to spam or bulk mail folders. Receiving, downloading and printing related documents is the candidate's responsibility.

faq.question: Q1. Which degrees are accepted for the Genetic Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The notice accepts a Masters in Genetic Counselling, Human or Medical Genetics, Life Sciences, Psychology, Nursing or MSW.

faq.question: Q2. Is experience compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates need a minimum of 01 year of experience in Genetic Counselling.

faq.question: Q3. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: It runs for six months at first and may be extended based on performance and the institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q4. How will I know my interview date?
faq.answer: Information about the interview date is sent by email, and only to eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What happens if I do not bring original documents to the interview?
faq.answer: You will not be allowed to appear. Originals must support the date of birth, qualifications, experience and other details given in the online form.

faq.question: Q6. Do internal candidates need any extra document?
faq.answer: Yes. They need to submit a NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q7. Will accommodation be provided to candidates from outside Varanasi?
faq.answer: No. The notice says accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Who is the employer for this post?
faq.answer: The advertisement is issued by M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., the outsourcing agency that supplies manpower services to HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi, on contract basis.
